name: hydra-tui-screenshot
description: Captures a real `hydra tui` terminal session and renders it to a PNG for docs/README use.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "for (const a of ['arm64', 'x64']) try { require('fs').chmodSync('node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-' + a + '/spawn-helper', 0o755) } catch {}"
